metadata.title: Non-Perturbative Yang-Mills Spectral Mass Gap, Confinement Area Law, and OS2 Reflection Positivity on 156-Qubit IBM Quantum Hardware in Unified Phase Dynamics
metadata.description:
We report direct superconducting quantum-hardware verification of the confinement spectral gap, Wilson-loop area law, Euclidean transfer-matrix exponential decay, and Osterwalder–Schrader reflection positivity (OS2) motivated by the autonomous path-contour formulation of four-dimensional SU(3) Yang–Mills theory in Unified Phase Dynamics (Ψ[Σ]) by H. Pavliuk.

  • Live 156-Qubit Execution (ibm_marrakesh, Job ID dc42sadhdvas73boss30): 33 quantum circuits executed at 4,096 shots each (135,168 physical measurements, unmitigated) across a six-point gauge-coupling scan g2 ∈ [1.00, 2.50] of a gauge-invariant 3-plaquette Kogut–Susskind reduction.
  • Non-Zero Spectral Gap & Wilson Area Law: Real hardware resolves a strictly positive gap ΔQPU ∈ [1.2396, 1.6258] (49.3σ–59.9σ > 0) alongside simultaneous area-law decay across 1×1, 1×2, and 1×3 Wilson loops (σlat,QPU = 0.1253 → 0.8418).
  • Euclidean Transfer-Matrix Slope: Block-encoded imaginary-time damping recovers ΔEUCLID,QPU = 1.3118 against exact 1.3243 (0.94% discrepancy).
  • OS2 Positivity vs. Ghost Sector: Swap-tests measure λmin,QPU = +0.3643 ± 0.0146 > 0 (Voronoi target +0.4131) separated cleanly from an Ostrogradsky Lee–Wick ghost control (−0.5684 ± 0.0129 < 0).
  • 4D Continuum Anchor: Zero-parameter 4D SU(3) calculations in Unified Phase Dynamics yield Δ0++ = 1.654 GeV matching Lattice QCD (1.65 ± 0.10 GeV) and full glueball tower concordance within 0.00σ–0.125σ.
